cases.name: a failed background inventory read makes the headline and retained folder facts unconfirmed despite fresh status
count provenance is shared by Library, Browse, removal and status rows (cap=true)
count provenance is shared by Library, Browse, removal and status rows (cap=undefined)
nested registrations have independent expansion, roving focus and parent recovery for each occurrence
ordinary Browse reloads roots on show and replaces cached children on each expansion
a failed child reload preserves cached rows and exposes Retry, which replaces them on success
complete root coverage wins over a global meaning-work block affecting other folders
remaining source and rebuild messages use reading/search-data wording and preserve consequences
V1: with no AI installed the Library says each fact once and names meaning only as Search by meaning
V2: a provisional state that is not an observed rebuild is not called "Rebuilding"
V2: walk codes are plain words, with codes only behind developer tools
V4: Browse lists folders and then files by name
V4: a total of one file reads "1 file"
V5: the shared formatter groups digits even where the runtime does not
V5: Library and Browse show one count per folder, the newest either of them read
V5: a counted folder read that finishes after a newer counts-free read still delivers its count
V6: when Read everything again completes, the folders are read again so Read shows the new time
V7: when the Engine cannot be reached, Read everything again says so in plain words; developer tools add the Engine message
V7: maintenance actions the command palette shows without developer tools do not say index
duplicate folder occurrences keep one real tree tab stop and keyboard navigation follows the focused occurrence
a background child reload retains cached rows and real focus, then recovers to the correct parent if the focused file disappears
V4: an open folder with nothing to say adds no band above the tree
V8: moving focus out of an open menu closes it, by Shift+Tab or otherwise; one menu is open at a time
